lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are arranged in a semi-regular multi-row grid posterior to the gill slits, with clusters roughly aligned in vertical columns and horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the visible flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least two horizontal linear ridges are visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition with light-reflecting superior edges and shadowed inferior edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least two symbiotic fish (remoras) swimming adjacent to the ventral-posterior section of the visible shark flank.
